# EspressoDrink

[Index](../index.md) · [Rules](../rules.md) · [Sources](../sources.md)

A drink built on a shot of espresso.

- Abstract: it has no members of its own, only its subclasses do.
- Is a: [Drink](c-drink.md)
- Subclasses: [MilkDrink](c-milk-drink.md), [PureEspresso](c-pure-espresso.md), [SweetenedDrink](c-sweetened-drink.md)

- **pullVolumeMl:** Milliliters of espresso pulled for one drink.
- **contains:** What goes into the drink.
- **origin:** Where the drink was first made.
- **pourOrder:** What goes in the cup first, and what goes on top.
- **variationOf:** A drink this one is a twist on.

## Decisions

<a id="d-386rne"></a>
### Drinks keep their own names

**Decision.** Espresso, Ristretto, Lungo and the other drinks keep the names a menu uses.

**Why.** Baristas say Lungo, not LungoEspresso. The parent names group them, so the children don't repeat a word.

**Explains the rules:** `naming-subclass-names-consistent`
